program.name: Climber EMOM
program.subject: Climber / pull strength
program.blurb: Climbing on the clock: pull-up EMOMs with core, hang EMOMs with back work.
program.about: Climbing strength on the clock. One day is a pull-up EMOM followed by core for body tension; the other a hang and lock-off EMOM followed by back and rear-shoulder work. EMOMs let you do a lot of pulling at good quality. Abs finish every session. Both later levels add reps and time.
program.split: Pull EMOM & core / hang EMOM & back
